sun.awt.event

类 IgnorePaintEvent

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.util.EventObject
      • java.awt.AWTEvent
        • java.awt.event.ComponentEvent
          • java.awt.event.PaintEvent
            • sun.awt.event.IgnorePaintEvent
  • 所有已实现的接口:
    Serializable

    public class IgnorePaintEvent
extends PaintEvent
    PaintEvents that are effectively ignored. This class is used only for tagging. If a heavy weight peer is asked to handle an event of this class it'll ignore it. This class is used by Swing. Look at javax.swing.SwingPaintEventDispatcher for more.
